invariants.rationale: rows is incremented unconditionally in this method, suggesting it is always greater than 0 at exit.
columns is the result of Math.max with rowColumns, both expected to be non-negative integers.
By the end of the method, the top cell's endRow is always set to true.
cells.peek() is called, which suggests the collection must not be empty at exit.
columns is set to Math.max(columns, rowColumns), so it must be at least as large as rowColumns at this point.
